name: Fieldset
summary: Native field grouping primitive with a first visible legend, optional associated description, required canonical-content slot, and native disabled propagation.

anatomy.name: root
anatomy.description: Native fieldset wrapper for a related group of form controls.

anatomy.name: legend
anatomy.description: Group label rendered as the fieldset legend.

anatomy.name: description
anatomy.description: Optional helper text that describes the group.

anatomy.name: content
anatomy.description: Canonical child controls or fields that retain their own names, values, validity, and behavior.

sizes.name: default
sizes.description: Default group padding and legend size.

states.name: disabled
states.description: Native disabled propagation makes descendant controls unavailable and excludes them from submission.

behavior.name: nativeGroup
behavior.description: Targets should preserve native fieldset and legend semantics for related control groups.

behavior.name: groupDescription
behavior.description: Optional descriptions should be associated with the group when the target platform supports it.

behavior.name: descendantOwnership
behavior.description: Canonical descendants own values, validation, events, and reset; Fieldset owns only grouping, caption, description, and native group disabling.

properties.name: content
properties.description: Canonical related controls or fields contained by the group.

properties.name: description
properties.description: Optional helper text for the complete control group.

properties.name: disabled
properties.description: Disables every native control contained by the fieldset.

properties.name: describedBy
properties.description: Id reference for the optional group description.

accessibility: Use a native fieldset and legend for related form controls when available.
Keep the legend concise and visible.
Use aria-describedby for group-level helper text when present.
Use disabled on the fieldset to disable all grouped controls together.
Remember that controls inside the first legend are exempt from native fieldset disabling.
Do not use fieldset only as a visual card when there is no form-control group.
Keep descendant labels self-explanatory because assistive technologies vary in how often they repeat the legend.

web.notes: Implemented by native fieldset/legend elements plus a canonical .fieldset__content slot in components/css/forms.css; no runtime is required.

shopify.notes: Shopify Liquid can render native fieldset groups with the same class contract.
